newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta bourse to launch new share index.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta bourse to launch new share index.

text.p: Jakarta's stock exchange will launch a new share index on February 24 along side Indonesia's present composite index and sectoral index.
The exchange said in the announcement that the new LQ 45 index would represent price share movements of 45 companies based on their liquidity and market capitalisation.
"The components of the index will be evaluated every three months by using the last 12 month's daily data," it said.
The exchange said the method of calculating the LQ45 index would be the same as the composite index and sectoral index.
The calculation uses the market capitalisation of the stocks divided by their basic value multiplied by 100.
The LQ45 index will be retroactively calculated from July 13, 1994, with 100 as the base value, the statement said.
Astra International, Bank Negara Indonesia, Bimantara Citra, Citra Marga, Gudang Garam, Indosat and Telkom were among the companies included on the list.
